title: deps(v18): resolve @objectstack/* 18.0.0-next.2 and follow its contract (objectui#12626)
body:
Fixes #12626
Clause-②: yes
Part of #12592 (items 1 and 2)

Moves objectui's lockfile from `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.1` to `18.0.0-next.2` (npm `next`, built from objectstack `e5136ff10f`; the `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.2` tag peels to it) and follows the contract changes that reach objectui. objectui#12592 items 1 and 2 ride here, as the card directs; its item 3 (section density on the page hosts) stays on objectui#12592.

## What changed

- **Lockfile.** All seven `@objectstack/*` packages objectui resolves (`client`, `core`, `formula`, `lint`, `sdui-parser`, `spec`, `types`) were published at `18.0.0-next.2` and now resolve there; none is left at `next.1`. Regenerated by pnpm only: `pnpm -r up --no-save '@objectstack/*'`, then `pnpm dedupe`. A plain `up` resolved `@objectstack/core`'s zod at 4.6.7 next to the tree's 4.6.5 and gave `@objectstack/spec` two peer contexts; `pnpm dedupe` collapses that to one spec and one zod 4 (4.6.7). The dedupe also moves eight unrelated transitive patch versions (`brace-expansion`, `bson`, `dompurify`, `fast-uri`, `is-core-module`, `resolve`, `seroval` with `seroval-plugins`, `use-sync-external-store`). `check:lockfile-integrity` and `check:lockfile-dedupe` are green.
- **Range floors.** Two floors move to `^18.0.0-next.2`; all other ranges stay at `^18.0.0-next.1`.
  - `@object-ui/types`: forced. The page node now imports `checkPageRegionPlacement` and `checkPageDefaultPlacement`, which next.1 does not export. With the floor put back at next.1, `check:spec-floors` reports `floor-too-low` for both symbols.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell`: objectui#12592. With the interim deleted, the dialog's bound comes from next.2's derivation. On next.1 that derivation answers `full`.
- **`@object-ui/types`: next.2's two new `PageSchema` checks (objectstack `a69a40a5`, objectstack#23708).**
  - `checkPageRegionPlacement` is attached on `PageNodeSchema` and `PageKindNodeSchema`. It reads `kind`, `template` and each region's `name`. objectui's region carries `name` with the same meaning: `page.tsx` places a region by its lowercased `name`, as the check does.
  - `checkPageDefaultPlacement` judges `isDefault` by the page's `type`. On the `page` node `type` is the component discriminator, so attached there it would refuse every `isDefault`. It is attached on the page-kind node, whose `type` is the page kind, and the census records it as not attachable on the `page` node.
- **objectui#12592 items 1–2 (objectstack `941c78ae`, objectstack#23747).**
  - `interimBoundedTaskFlowSurface` is deleted, and `AppContent` calls `deriveRecordFlowSurface` directly at its one call site.
  - `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521.test.tsx` is rewritten, not deleted. It pins the installed derivation's bounded answer for all four task flows, with the phone's `full` as the control, and keeps its real-dialog cells.
  - `recordSurface.test.ts` follows the spec: heavy task flows get `size: 'auto'` on desktop, and a new row pins `full` on mobile.
  - Letter B's item-2 split: the installed derivation reads only the field count and the viewport, so it keeps no full-screen arm for a form with an embedded child or line-items table. Nothing extra is pinned.
- **Mechanical follow-ons.**
  - `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` now names `18.0.0-next.2`.
  - The `check-lockfile-integrity` samples are re-keyed onto the next.2 snapshot keys.
  - The import-boundary census (`imported-defaults-8317`) names the two new checks.
  - `check:installed-pin-claims` named 31 stamped sites in 22 files. Each fact was re-measured on next.2, with next.1 as the control, before its stamp moved: a parse probe over both installed spec and lint builds, whose output diff was empty; the green type-check for the type-level readings; and the green test files for the facts they assert. Every reading is the same on both versions.

## Clause-② accept-set moves (`@object-ui/types`, both faces)

These documents were accepted on next.1 and are refused on next.2, with the spec's own message at the same path:

- On a `kind: 'full'` page, a region whose `name` the `template` does not place (default template: `header`, `sidebar`, `main`, `aside`, `footer`), or a second region for a slot another region already fills. Refused at `regions.N.name`, on the `page` node and the page-kind node.
- `isDefault: true` on a page-kind node that is not a `record` page bound to an `object`. Refused at `isDefault`.
- Controls that pass on both: placed regions; any region on the `dashboard` template; a non-`full` kind; a bound `record` page with `isDefault`; `isDefault` on a `type: 'page'` node.

HotCRM's own metadata trips both checks on next.2 (`home.page.ts`: `isDefault` on a `home` page, regions `left_sidebar` / `right_sidebar`), and three pages also trip the retired `template: 'full-width'`. This is a real producer writing what the spec now refuses, read through `objectstack dev`'s compile.

## Browser reading (HotCRM Leads → New)

The backend was HotCRM on `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.2`: a scratch copy with its pins moved to next.2; `/api/v1/health` answered `18.0.0-next.2`. To get it to boot, the spec's own remedies were applied to that scratch copy only: `full-width` → `default`, `isDefault` removed from the home page, and its regions renamed `sidebar` / `aside`. The console ran from this branch.

- 1440: the dialog is 1024 px wide (`sm:max-w-5xl`), the same as PR #12546's landing reading, and now produced by the spec. https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/303360ece0d0d5edb7d1ed87b9cd95ba2c69df4e/docs/design/findings/12626/leads-new-1440.png?raw=true
- 390: the full-screen sheet (390 × 844), unchanged. https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/303360ece0d0d5edb7d1ed87b9cd95ba2c69df4e/docs/design/findings/12626/leads-new-390.png?raw=true

The screenshots are on `claude/issue-12626-evidence` only. This branch adds no PNG.

## Test evidence (head `371c3a2`)

- Build: turbo, everything but the site, 43/43 on `56da05c`. The changed packages were rebuilt (29/29) after the code commits.
- Type-check: 81/81 on `56da05c`. On the final code, `types`, `app-shell`, `plugin-view` and `components` with their dependencies: 33/33.
- Full suite on next.2 (`56da05c`, 16 shards): 5,223 files. Every red is in the table above.
- After the fixes (`9ab905b`), targeted runs, all exit 0:
  - `packages/types/` 383/383
  - `packages/components/` 388 + 1 skipped
  - `packages/cli/` + `packages/plugin-view/` 107/107
  - `apps/console/` + `examples/` 253/253
  - `packages/app-shell/` 1,432 + 1 skipped
  - `scripts/` 185 + 2 skipped; the one red file there is in Acceptance notes
- On `371c3a2`, after merging `main`: the 42 test files `main` brought, 42/42; this PR's pins and ratchets, 10 files, 728/728.
- Negative control: the branch's code and pins with next.1 installed (BASE lockfile and manifests) are red: `recordSurface` 2, the 12521 pin 8, and `7715` and `8317` red. On next.2 they are green.
- Ablations (each mutated, seen red, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `AppContent` `=== 'full'` → `!== 'full'`: 4 red.
  - Region check removed from `PageNodeSchema`: 3 red.
  - `isDefault` check removed from the kind node: 1 red.
  - `isDefault` check added to `PageNodeSchema`: 1 red (the control).
- Gates at exit 0: `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:spec-floors`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`.
- Lint: eslint `--no-inline-config` over the 29 touched code files reports 0 errors.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12626-spec-next-2.md` follows the repo's pre mode (`tag: next`). It bumps every changed released package as `minor` (never `major`), says that the console and runner bundle next.2, and lists the dialog change and the two accept-set narrowings.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` went red 2 times out of 7 on this branch, both under heavy load: one case in `FormulaFunctions.dateOnlyZone-10866` read `11:00` for an expected `03:00`, which is another zone's clock. It was green the other 5 times, green 3 of 3 on BASE, and green when the pin file runs alone in a forked child. `FormulaFunctions` imports nothing from `@objectstack`, so this is not a next.2 contract change and is left here as a load-order observation.
- objectui#12406: the Studio facet can still write the two keys next.2 refuses once a business unit is named. Its anchor pin does not cover that write, which is why neither the pin nor the type-check went red.
